definition: One point per retained promotion record. Count distinct recorded context identifiers observed from the first selected record through the current record in source order.
scope: Observed identifiers conditional on admitted program events; not dataset/family coverage,independent tasks,proposal success,adapter retention or writer/map learning. Starts within this window,not at the first-ever promotion. No attempt or total-population denominator supplied.
source_binding: Recorded context identifiers only; exact runtime/evaluation-population/input-closure/checkpoint and independent-learning qualification remain unbound.
